_comment: Owner-approved growth for the import-boundary ratchet (tools/check-import-boundaries.cjs --base). --base reads this file
from the BASE ref, never from the PR being checked: an entry takes effect only after it has merged to the base branch in
its own PR, and --base fails a PR that changes this file together with any tools/*.baseline.json. One entry lets exactly
one rule and file go from exactly `from` (the base count, 0 = no entry) to exactly `to`; delete it once the using PR has
merged (--base reports it STALE from then on). Never widen `to` in place. Shape (every key required except target):
`target` is the resolved import target exactly as --list prints it; with it, the growth must be edges to that target.
